== Strategy ==

This is My Attempt to make a Jawa Deck. Using the Utinni(V) and other such methods, Jawa's are easy to deploy, leaving your opponent either the choice to not leave force during his turn, or to make deployment for me easier.

**Strategy 1**
--------------

Jawas are cheap - Stick Nebit and Three other Jawas with him at the Jawa Canyon and A Wittin at the Audience Chamber = 17 Power, 2 Battle Destiny and a Minus 3 for your opponent's battle destiny. All for a few force.

**Strategy 2**
--------------

Three Locations in this order: A, B, C

Two Jawas at A, Two Jawas at C, Opponent force drains at B, use two force to reduce B drain by 2.

Herat can play Utinni(V) to cancel force drains also.

Undercover spies prevent force drains from far away.

**Strategy 3**
--------------

Interrupt Play. If the opponent doesnt have the ant-sabbacc card in their deck, theyll pay for it. Average destiny is something like 3.27 or something, and so usually my Jawas will win. Secondly, Reegesk takes styuff from theit lost pile so i can lose it to my own. Retrieval is a bit bad though - i dont really know of a single card that would really make the retrieval engine for this deck, besides Scum and Villainy.
